title: French Melon Tart with Roast Almonds
description: A sweet and elegant dessert featuring a melon filling atop a buttery pastry crust, finished with toasted roast almonds.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, confectioners' sugar, and salt. Add the cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture into a 9-inch (23cm) tart pan with a removable bottom. Chill in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Line the tart shell with parchment paper and fill with pie weights or dried beans. Bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the parchment paper and pie weights or beans. Return the tart shell to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the granulated sugar, almond extract, and egg. Add the melon and stir until well combined.
Pour the melon mixture into the tart shell and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the filling is set.
While the tart is baking, toast the roast almonds in a 350°F (180°C) oven for 5-7 minutes or until fragrant.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Sprinkle the toasted roast almonds over the top of the tart before serving.
